# arianet_server (Resource)

A cloud server. Maps to `/cloud/v1/servers`. Creating, resizing (`plan_id`) and deleting wait for the server's action to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_plans" "fra" {
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
}

resource "arianet_ssh_key" "me" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "arianet_server" "web" {
  name        = "web-1"
  datacenter  = "eu-central-1"
  plan_id     = data.arianet_plans.fra.plans[0].id
  image       = "ubuntu-24.04"
  ssh_key_ids = [arianet_ssh_key.me.id]
  backups     = true

  labels = {
    env  = "prod"
    role = "web"
  }

  user_data = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages: [nginx]
  EOT

  timeouts {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter (location) code, see the `arianet_locations` data source. Changing it replaces the server.
- `image` (String) Image to create the server from: the `image` of an `arianet_image(s)` data source (a system/app image slug, or a snapshot/backup reference). Changing it replaces the server.
- `name` (String) Server name: letters, digits, dots and dashes, up to 63 characters.
- `plan_id` (Number) Plan ID, see the `arianet_plans` data source. Changing it resizes the server (`change_plan`).

### Optional

- `backups` (Boolean) Whether daily backups are enabled (billed extra).
- `delete_snapshots` (Boolean) On destroy: also delete the server's snapshots (sent only when true; needs a cloud-service that supports it).
- `enable_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether the server gets a public IPv4 address (API default: true). Changing it replaces the server.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether the server gets a public IPv6 address where the datacenter has IPv6. Changing it replaces the server.
- `firewall_ids` (Set of Number) Firewalls applied directly to this server. Changes apply/remove the firewalls. Do not combine with `apply_to` of `arianet_firewall` or `arianet_firewall_attachment` for the same server.
- `keep_backups` (Boolean) On destroy: keep the server's backups (sent only when true; needs a cloud-service that supports it).
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `network_ids` (Set of Number) Private networks the server is attached to at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `placement_group_id` (Number) Placement group to create the server in. Changing it replaces the server.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Whether the resource is protected from deletion. Must be set to false before the resource can be destroyed.
- `protection_rebuild` (Boolean) Whether the server is protected from being rebuilt.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the account's saved SSH keys (`arianet_ssh_key`) installed at creation. Changing it replaces the server.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) Public keys (OpenSSH lines) installed at creation in addition to `ssh_key_ids`. Changing it replaces the server.
- `start_after_create` (Boolean) Whether the server is started once created. Only used at creation.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_data` (String) Cloud-init user data. Changing it replaces the server.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `disk_gb` (Number) Root disk size in GB.
- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the server is locked (e.g. by billing).
- `rescue_enabled` (Boolean) Whether rescue mode is on.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password returned once at creation (empty when SSH keys are used and the API returns none).
- `status` (String) Server status, e.g. `running` or `off`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A server is imported by its ID.
terraform import arianet_server.web 123
```
